notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/cc6a3c9ed149807815b0ec9e5348c97ee1e1cbb7.jpg[/img]
[h3]Greetings Climbers!
We have decided to help you with some Climber common questions based on opinions, reviews, and general discussion between players which already played the game:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]What type of game is Climber?[/b]
Climber: Sky is the Limit is a walking simulation game with some survival elements. You as a player become a winter climber whose goal is to push the summit. Mountains that are present in-game are only eight-thousanders that actually exist.

[*] [b]Simulation and survival elements - how come?[/b]
A walking simulator is based on some physical aspects of life. While pushing the summit you need to balance parameters like stamina, hunger, etc. Each mechanic plays a certain role in the game and players need to be aware of any unexpected situation.

[*] [b]Can I start an expedition without any preparation and climbing equipment?[/b]
No. Before starting the game you need to choose the necessary equipment and balance your backpack. Maintaining your additional weight in this game matters.

[*] [b]How many mountains can I expect in the game?[/b]
There is one tutorial mountain and five real ones - Manaslu, Cho-Oyu, Gasherbrum, K2, and Mount Everest.

[*] [b]Why are there only 5 mountains available?[/b]
We planned to deliver lots of mechanics and content for those 5 mountains, so we focused more on polishing existing peaks than adding more mountains with no exciting content.

[*] [b]Is there any chance to add more content to this game in the future?[/b]
Currently, our main goal is to fix and polish all issues posted by the players after release. But we are analyzing all possible ways to improve the gameplay and further development.

[*] [b]What about saving the game while climbing a certain mountain?[/b]
The Gameplay core is between starting an expedition and pushing the summit. There is no option to save the game between those points. So when you start the expedition you have two options - push the summit or fail on the way up!

[*] [b]Is there a multiplayer or coop mode?[/b]
For now, Climber: Sky is the Limit is Single-player only, however, you can compete with your friends on the Leaderboards. There is one for each in-game mountain, measuring the summit times, as well as, additional oxygen use.

[*] [b]Is this a more relaxing game based on climbing skills or I can speedrun to get the best mountain time?[/b]
You can experience both - either enjoy some deep, mountaineer mechanics or you can compete with others in order to achieve the best possible time in Leaderboards among other players. Climbing mechanics are pretty simple thus everyone can play this game.

[*] [b]Mouse and keyboard or controller support?[/b]
Currently, you can play only with a mouse and keyboard. But we are thinking about adding controller support.

[*] [b]What is the role of Leaderboards?[/b]
This feature was developed based on players' feedback. Some of you would like to challenge yourself to get the best possible result on each mountain. Timing and planning in this kind of gameplay are very important.

[*] [b]What about supporting Climber after its release?[/b]
Climber support is planned from a long-term perspective. Since the release, we have already delivered two patches based on players' feedback on Steam or our Discord dedicated channel. In the near future, we plan to deliver more as soon as players find some issues or suggest ideas to boost the gameplay.

[*] [b]How many languages does the game support?[/b]
We have 12 languages in the game - English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Hungarian, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Italian, and Turkish.
Some of them were delivered by the players. We encourage all the players to support us if any language is missing and you would like to help us localize Climber: Sky is the Limit. Simply contact us at [b]support@art-games.com[/b] or ping us on the Discord dedicated channel.

[*] [b]Where can I find the player.log file?[/b]
This is the full path on your local drive and depends what is your username:
“C:\Users\{YOUR_USER_NAME}\AppData\LocalLow\A2Softworks\Climber Sky is the Limit"
You can access AppData by searching for “%appdata%” in your system search.

[*] [b]If I find a bug during gameplay, where can I report it?[/b]
The best place is our Discord dedicated channel (#❄🐛bug-reports) or just send to [b]support@art-games.com[/b].

[*] [b]I would like to write/record a review or stream Climber: Sky is the Limit - how/where?[/b]
Great! Please send us an email: [b]media@art-games.com[/b]

[*] [b]Here are social media to follow Climber: Sky is the Limit:[/b]
Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/ClimberGame ]https://www.facebook.com/ClimberGame [/url]
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp ]https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp [/url]
[/list]

If you couldn't find the answer you're looking for, simply post a message in the Steam comments section or via our [url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp]Discord [/url]server.

notes.title: THE EXPEDITION STARTS NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/c39b949bb8da5c0ce845be6d46138b0a17716e5a.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Release Day is finally here![/b][/h2]
[h3]After a long wait, lots of sweat, and thousands of development hours we can begin the mountain expedition together. It won't be easy but sure it will be fun![/h3]

[previewyoutube=jN9vT4hmBCM;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]There were many attempts to push the summit - at least they tried... Brave and young climbers...

Hours in the gym, improving the immunology system, exceeding body limits, and studying the mountain routes over and over again.

But nobody couldn't predict the brutal force of nature which is the weather. And what about the hunger, stamina, energy, and supply running out? Without planning you will skate on a thin ice which is not a good idea somewhere in the wilderness.

Nevertheless, are you ready to take a shot? Be careful with making a decision - there might be a steep learning curve awaiting. Ready to challenge yourself?[/i]

Few starting tips:
[list]
[*] Before setting off study the map of the peak you're trying to summit, it will give you information about the dangers and risks waiting for you.
[*] Having appropriate tools when needed is the key to survival. Each piece of equipment can help you during your climb, but also weighs you down, making each step a bit harder. 
[*] Ensure you have enough food to recover your strength, a warm jacket, and a sleeping bag to warm up after a full-day climb.
[*] Good timing also plays a great role during the expedition. In the high mountains, where weather changes quickly and night falls very fast, plan ahead to set up camp in the right place to survive the night or the harsh weather.
[/list]

[b]If you got any questions, or ideas for further development, 
wanna brag about your summit time, or just talk with us visit our Discord server![/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/ba091f900f0552de1167bbe4430dfe018c5caa62.png[/img][/url]

[b]See you on the Trail 
AGS Team[/b]

notes.title: What to expect in Climber: Sky is the Limit - Free Trial
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/a61072d903a7f4f627eecebc4f7374c4b0bfa648.jpg[/img]

Hello Climbers!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1963500/Climber_Sky_is_the_Limit__Free_Trial/][b]Climber: Sky is the Limit - Free Trial[/b][/url] release is coming soon, so we thought we'll tell you what you'll be able to experience in it.

[h2]2 Expeditions[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/2631b7df661760ac61d6b9f2f970cf372a5674c5.png[/img]

The first two in-game mountains will be yours to conquer. 
First, the [b]Tutorial Mountain[/b] will teach you the basics of the game, while being reasonably easy to summit, then the [b]Manaslu[/b] will test what you've learned. 

[b]Tutorial Mountain[/b] is a fictional peak (somewhere in Nepal) created from scratch by us, to help you better understand core game mechanics and prepare you for the real challenge.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/5b6cf7e538d0fadf57a1ff7c904b6c7067ad47e2.jpg[/img]

[b]Manaslu[/b] is where the real fun begins, while still having some tutorial elements, this mountain presents a challenge for beginner climbers. 
The characteristic shape of the mountain, resembling two horns is an experimental polygon for climbers. A [i]relatively safe[/i] route for climbing a peak at the height of 8156 m. will allow you to prepare for expeditions on higher and harder eight-thousanders. 
[i]Relatively safe [/i] doesn't mean you'll reach the peak on your first try, 
be prepared...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/77b25786c46ce9cea18756969fc6e1ee004d8981.jpg[/img]

[h2]44 Items[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/70411ceaccf97dbde5837247c43d5289d593397c.jpg[/img]

Preparation is key in the mountains, and we'll give you all the means to be prepared. 
Both peaks will have Required Items you'll need to attempt the expedition to ease you on your first contact with the game. 
But after buying them you'll still have some money left for your own additional preparations 

The equipment you'll be able to use varies, you'll have to balance out costs and profits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/9f8fb9b1e7edfcd9fbcb209f6f2871609f569f57.png[/img]

[h2]Loads of Challenges[/h2]

notes.title: New Mountain - Mount Everest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/fa275336244a53eb869c45c9c17984125e4f53d6.png[/img]
[h3]Hello Climbers, it's finally the time to reveal the mountain that had to be in the game, the highest peak on earth - Mount Everest. Get ready for the long climb![/h3]

[h3]Let us be your guide:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/c100a0df051611dcaf6a6a82288b9cf9491b20c0.png[/img]

Highest (8848 m.) and the most popular summit in the world. The path to the top is technically varied. It runs through challenging Khumbu Glacier (which will check your ice picking skills), breath-taking, avalanche threatened Wester Cauldron, and the serac fraughted mountain wall of Lhotse. From the top of the world, you'll be able to see a breathtaking Himalayan panorama.

[h3]In-game map of the mountain:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/b018df4feaf3db1ba4a8b64d08ea8c4e29e8d199.jpg[/img]

[b]A. Camp One, from here you start your way to the top. The road splits into two paths.[/b]
1. Moderately easy path, leads through boulders and icy rocks left over from the glacier.
2. An alternative path to the second camp, through the tunnel. It starts with an ice-covered area. Steep slopes. 

[b]B. A convenient place to camp. [/b]
3. The area full of ice crevices. Bring a ladder and watch your steps. 
4. Route through a steep, icy ascent. 
5. Very steep surface covered with ice and wide rift to overcome.
Then the route splits into two paths. 
6. Vertical ice wall - ice axes required. 
7. A steep trail between the rocks. 

[b]C. Another place to set up a camp. Large exposure. Two paths lead to the top. [/b]
8. A stone climb ended with an ice wall. 
9. Alternative path - climbing wall. 

[b]D. A place to regenerate before attacking the top.[/b]
10. The last leg before the summit. Dangerous and steep ice-covered area.

The weather on Mount Everest is not as harsh as on some other mountains, which means you can prepare some lighter clothes to conserve your stamina (and money - [b]or better buy some extra food[/b]) [b]You gonna need it for the long journey ahead.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/4c8c7a0c9b7e169e72a3a9d7d2ff8b7da3c5fa37.png[/img]

One of the hardest and most memorable parts of the Mount Everest climb is the serac area full of ice crevices, you'll have to carefully place your ladder and sometimes use some extra belay to traverse through. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/d8a955f08d485efce3932a60e68b9a49287a4c4e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/d5c6f4d1faab057fcec8690efb74bef20105274f.png[/img]

[b]The routes of Mount Everest also abound in vertical rock climbing walls, they are one of the longest and hardest[/b] (have few and less certain fulcrums). You have to keep your stamina high if you want to overcome them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/efffe16a9878362c1cf3b35140c3eefbd961d270.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/08b142398fa39adcaeff7de7866b4258d2974319.png[/img]

The summit push itself can also catch you off guard. [b]Conserve your ice screws to the very end![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/37ac8a4c7d8b86bc9ddb70b8fec6d3bc715fc762.png[/img]

[b]There is a lot more to the routes of Mount Everest, but we let you find that out yourselves!

Remember to follow Climber: Sky is the limit not to miss any of the incoming devlogs,
if you want to chat with us visit our Discord channel!
Climber: Sky is the Limit team[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/ea7740b3445b6de5a79ccebc2e2b9a14654bbb6b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: New Mountain - K2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/eda052b81a8106400a57d1791eefe7eddbe996fe.jpg[/img]
[h3]Hello Climbers, today we want to show you another mountain recently implemented in the game - K2,  widely considered the planet's toughest and most dangerous mountain to climb. 
It is no different in Climber: Sky is the Limit![/h3]

[h3]Let us be your guide on Savage Mountain:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/0cdc41e1cc37cb259f341c588b8a01ce4741cfe4.png[/img]

The most difficult mountain in the world, the classic pyramid shape. From the base to the top (8611 m.) the steepness of the slopes varies between 45 – 90 degrees. It's about two and a half football fields shorter than Everest, but it's widely considered the planet's toughest and most dangerous mountain to climb. Every fourth climber never returns after reaching the summit. 
K2 expedition will require using various techniques. 
To this date, only 377 people have summited the mountain. 
[b]Become one of them in Climber: Sky is the Limit.[/b]

[h3]In-game map of the mountain:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/5be00fd74c1addd4da692a11f93b67ed90d77609.png[/img]

[b]A. Camp one, from here you start your way to the top.
1. Straight road, divided into two routes leading to the top 
2. The route starts in the crevice and goes through the icy tunnel 
3. Moderately mild, icy area with rocks. Use of hooks and screws recommended.

B. Convenient place to camp and regenerate.
1. Very steep and narrow passage between the rocks. 
2. Black Pyramid - a characteristic rock climbing wall.

C. Place for another camp before climbing with ice axes. Exposure area. 
6. Vertical ice wall - ice axes required. 
7. Steep and dangerous entry between the rocks. Risk of stone avalanches.
8. The last approach before the summit. Icy area with sharp rocks. Exposure.

D. The beginning of the next route to the top. A place to camp and choose the strategy.
9. Steep approach along an icy slope. Large exposure. 
10. Narrow pass above the chasm. Steep, rocky terrain.

E. Last camping place on the second route, regain your strength before the final push.
11. Vertical Ice wall - ice axes required. The rift to overcome. 
12. Rock climbing wall, after overcoming it there are only a few steps to the summit. Exposure area.[/b]


K2 has one of the most extreme winter conditions among all of the in-game summits, you have to be appropriately prepared to stand a chance of summiting it. 
We recommend bringing the clothes with the highest insulation to push your temperature resistance to the limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/8c891a4cc43d4237d42450e590aaee184fb28058.png[/img]

[b]Otherwise, you may freeze to your demise easily.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/8b7b1e3087a70fc7323c6f8a8d1b8d5a05629896.png[/img]


[b]Depending on the path you choose you may encounter:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/bf9433592e2d3ad23d0ac936b729cc91e2d8b0fc.png[/img]
slippery ice tunnels,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/f1634b639de776eded5a613cce26d54345d5dfb8.png[/img]
loads of steep walls surrounded by rocks,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/58bf6b0ff54da16154de75fca9ef69d439d09435.png[/img]
and the famous [b]Black Pyramid[/b]!

Remember to bring lots of extra belay with you, you'll need those hooks, ice screws, pickets, and long ropes on your way to the top.

[b]More exciting things await on the routes of K2, but they are yours to find. [/b]

[b]Remember to follow Climber: Sky is the limit not to miss any of the incoming devlogs, 
if you want to chat with us visit our Discord channel!
Climber: Sky is the Limit team[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/zW9RBBhjyC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/ea7740b3445b6de5a79ccebc2e2b9a14654bbb6b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: New Mountain - Gasherbrum I!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/5dc97d048f32d69909f8da9e982e4cb453cdf0d5.jpg[/img]
[h3]Hello Climbers, today we want to show you another mountain recently implemented in the game - Gasherbrum I, as well as a new gameplay concept we're testing right now. [/h3]

[h3]Let us be your guide:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/8049943af24e1fa032e4ebaf838bfe4dd5ecf3e3.png[/img]
The highest summit in the Gasherbrum nest, at the height of 8080 m. In order to start climbing, you have to traverse an 11 km glacier filled with ice rifts. After a technically demanding road in a couloir, you reach the distinctive summit in the shape of a fish's fin.

[h3]In-game map of the mountain:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/c9aeb22a61a78cd4d285127aa241d26430b4789e.png[/img]
[b]1. The starting point of the expedition, an easy way to the first camp.

A. Camp one, from here you'll start your way to the top.
2. Dangerous approach, the long icy glacier slope between the rocks, very steep. 
3. Land decline, boulders, and the beginning of the chasms. 
4. Large risk of falling rocks, a chasm to overcome.  
5. Vertical ice wall. Climbing axes are required. 

B. Convenient place to regenerate after climbing. 
6. Gentle approach to another ice wall. 

C. The last place to set a camp safely.
7. Snowy and steep traverse with a chasm in the middle and on the left side. 
8. Summit road. Moderately easy in good weather. Starts with a short climb.[/b]


The hardest moments of Gasherbrum I climb will await you at the start, the glacier slope requires serious preparation (bring loads of ice screws and at least 100-150m of rope with you!) and belay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/924b5a7cb93a672119b9e18e3051baf4c1b00bb8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/4e1fcda0b47188222c3c35d0eb2a30e86a4e66c5.gif[/img]

[b]Watch out for how much rope you got left![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/eb00c44dab796337017958bdbbcaceb5f311724e.gif[/img]

Another difficult moment comes when traversing huge chasms, you'll have to figure out how to get past them, because the ladder may simply not be enough!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/9ce5e6491ef70ed8db453362ca064208f4e97390.png[/img]

More exciting things await you on the way to the Gasherbrum I top, 
but we'll let you discover them out for yourself when Climber: Sky is the Limit will be out!

We'll keep you updated with all the stuff it's currently going on in the game development, 
feel free to chat with us on our Discord channel.

Climber: Sky is the Limit team

notes.title: New Mountain - Cho Oyu!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/303ba0c2e0a9b0e6f14d94e19c81e3b6b6ce15a5.jpg[/img]
[h3]Hello Climbers!
Our team is working hard on implementing new things into the game, so it can have as much content for the release as possible!
Right now we're working on adding the new mountain to the game - Cho Oyu.[/h3]

[h3][b]Let us be your guide:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/e0729bc9cf53a6fab240c1d4bcfbfb4e56aabacb.png[/img]
The sixth-highest mountain in the world at 8,188 meters (26,864 ft) above sea level, Its towering peak stands with Everest well above the surrounding mountains. 
Cho Oyu is considered the easiest eight-thousander with the lowest death-summit ratio (1⁄25th of Annapurna's). 
Don't let it fool you though, without the good preparations it can still be dangerous in real life, as well as in Climber: Sky is the Limit.

[h3][b]In-game map of the mountain:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/e6b73c7e9384a75002b897a18607b8f83ee946cf.png[/img]
A. Camp one, from here you start your way to the top. 
1. The path leading to the second camp through the Ice tunnel on the left or on the right through a vertical Ice wall. 
2. Steep, icy approach along the ridge leading to the second camp. Large exposure. 
3. Flat terrain with crevasses. Exposure. 

B. A convenient place to set up the second camp. 
4. A steep slope, the route leads through rock shelves and chasms. 
5. Dangerous area of falling stones. 
6. Vertical climbing wall.
7. Icy traverse with a chasm on the left side, use of a rope Is recommended. Large exposure. 

C. The last convenient place to camp. It is worth taking a break before entering the road leading to the top through the ridge. 
8. Summit road. Moderately difficult in good weather, leading to high exposure. Finished with climbing with ice axes. 


[b]During the climb, you'll face:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Multiple crevasses (new ladder mechanic, not available in the demo, incoming btw.!)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/40256b4fd9a9dcdafd9bad6bc45bada55c412caf.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Tall vertical climbing wall[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/e703b8610a657d203ecdf6ba88909d60052651c7.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Falling rocks (New addition - BEWARE!)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/93dbc3747db40328fd03887b5a7736b0baae25b3.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Opportunities for an ice ax climb. (new climbing animations!)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/b651a9cbe996051c48005a60552d0155e2bad6e2.gif[/img]
[*] [b]And many more for you to uncover during your own expedition![/b]
[/list]
We'll keep you updated with all the stuff it's currently going on in the game development, 
Feel free to play the free demo available on our Steam Page and chat with us on our Discord Channel.

Till the next time...
Climber: Sky is the Limit team.

notes.title: Necessary Equipment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/80ba555f6991680b7b551035349f78a3ebc8cd8c.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Every expedition starts with the preparation of the necessary gear.[/b][/h2]
[b]Climber: Sky is the limit is no different.[/b]

[b]The smallest thing you'll pack into your backpack before you set off can be decisive in your journey to the top.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/5e7490b6eab0f34a5fa397fc712d50cef66f4724.png[/img]

Depending on your prestige level and the funds you have available to acquire items of various qualities. 
[h3][b]Each piece of equipment improves your chances of conquering the mountain in some way:[/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/e724c620d9f870991601f45767e7b1d4423d2e2e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Protect you from the harsh weather conditions - [b]increasing your maximum temperature stat[/b] 
[*] Allow for more freedom of movement, being more comfortable - [b]increasing your maximum stamina[/b] 
[*] Utilize lighter materials - [b]lowering the overall weight of your equipment[/b] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/1a26c064d3bf05a886bd9da0fdf39746567c0bfc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Provide light[/b] (nighttime summit push will be almost infeasible without it), better headlamps will provide more light.
[*] Batteries provide extra illumination time, better batteries provide even more. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/f8faf365c40d053f667809788bf72b36d810f0c2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Allow for very steep and icy wall climbing[/b] 
[*] High-tier ice axes, thanks to better ergonomy, allow for more efficient climbing - [b]lower stamina consumption during traversing ice walls[/b] 
[*] Better Ice axes consist of lighter materials - [b]lowering the overall weight of equipmen[/b]t 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/6e3647fa258d974e64923cc71f71b2bd1d185326.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Extra belay, especially handy when traversing extremely slippery terrain[/b] 
[*] Depending on the topography you'll use [b]Hooks (rocks)[/b], [b]Ice screws (ice)[/b], or [b]Picket (snow)[/b] as a facilitator.
[*] High-tier ropes are [b]lighter and longer[/b] than their budget counterparts.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/a473800d5c231deadc1f506333032168c1d8deda.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Allow for traversing crevasses, you'll normally have to get around[/b]
[*] One of the heaviest in-game items, better models are a bit lighter, while maintaining durability.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/f306fecb9b31062c778f2f1c20d0bc2a19f965e1.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]All the necessary equipment you'll need to set up a camp and rest during an expedition.[/b] 
[*] Resting regains your [b]Stamina[/b], [b]Mental Condition[/b], and [b]Body Temperature[/b] while waiting out difficult weather conditions, or night. 
[*] High-tier tents are lighter
[*] High-tier sleeping mats provide you with a better and longer well-rested bonus (lowers stamina, mental health, and body temperature falloff)
[*] High-tier sleeping bags allow for health parameters regeneration even in very low outside temperature
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/453f18a047bc0a5542e5bdb87ef542bff2683dd2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Eating regenerates your Stamina, Mental Condition, and Food [/b]
[*] A warm meal ([b]must be prepared with the gas stove and a mess tin in the tent[/b]) will regenerate health parameters more than a cold one. It will raise and your body temperature too!
[*] Some food can have [b]additional effects[/b] on your climber. 
[/list]

[b]Now you know the basic in-game gear and will be ready to set off when the time comes.[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/00acea364b6971f06d19dfa0b2c009f985f022e2.png[/img]

notes.title: Taking first steps
notes.content:
[h3]Every expedition starts from planning and preparations. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/36a30345909cbfa647f22d069215fcdff667016e.png[/img]

That's why before making the first steps on the snow, you should learn what kind of obstacles you will encounter and how to approach them efficiently. To help you with that, each map will have a short introduction providing tips and informations about a trail you want to take as well as required items you will need to take to please your sponsors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/f49479101686f4285fe05c09acd1df104dc0afbb.png[/img]

Some items like ropes or hooks can be used only once so planning each part of the route is crucial. Otherwise, you'll have to start your adventure from the beginning losing not only your money but also your fame and prestige. 





Remember about our Kickstarter campaign! Follow the project and get notified at launch!

[url=https://bit.ly/ClimberKS][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/747a63af8f66a33e4aa84f83babfb423941002e6.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Climbing the wall
notes.content:
To climb the wall, approach it and press the interaction key. Easy, right? 
[b][h2]Not![/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/57d77db78c41f567f3772f8e6328e7eed8da42a8.gif[/img]

[h3]Each wall has its own difficulty, determined by dots on it and each dot indicates how hard the path you want to take is. Choosing a path with too many red dots may end in your character falling and eventually… death!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/452a4a9d2f6cc6e80db52468c3dda06671eee7fa.gif[/img]

[h3][h2]Watch your steps and choose the right path wisely! Remember to control your stamina and food level before moving forward![/h2]
[/h3]

[h3]To the next time, climbers![/h3]
